requirements_xml:
<requirements_list>
  <requirement id="R1">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The ShadowRoot interface must be exposed on Window.</description>
    <spec_quote>[Exposed=Window]
interface ShadowRoot : DocumentFragment {</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R2">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The ShadowRoot interface must inherit from DocumentFragment.</description>
    <spec_quote>interface ShadowRoot : DocumentFragment {</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R3">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>ShadowRoot must expose a readonly mode property.</description>
    <spec_quote>readonly attribute ShadowRootMode mode;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R4">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The ShadowRootMode enumeration must define the values "open" and "closed".</description>
    <spec_quote>enum ShadowRootMode { "open", "closed" };</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R5">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>ShadowRoot must expose a readonly delegatesFocus property.</description>
    <spec_quote>readonly attribute boolean delegatesFocus;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R6">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>ShadowRoot must expose a readonly serializable property.</description>
    <spec_quote>readonly attribute boolean serializable;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R7">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>ShadowRoot must expose a readonly slotAssignment property.</description>
    <spec_quote>readonly attribute SlotAssignmentMode slotAssignment;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R8">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The SlotAssignmentMode enumeration must define the values "manual" and "named".</description>
    <spec_quote>enum SlotAssignmentMode { "manual", "named" };</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R9">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>ShadowRoot must expose a readonly clonable property.</description>
    <spec_quote>readonly attribute boolean clonable;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R10">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>ShadowRoot must expose a readonly host property.</description>
    <spec_quote>readonly attribute Element host;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R11">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>ShadowRoot must expose an onslotchange event handler property.</description>
    <spec_quote>attribute EventHandler onslotchange;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R12">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>ShadowRoot must include the DocumentOrShadowRoot mixin, exposing a readonly customElementRegistry property.</description>
    <spec_quote>interface mixin DocumentOrShadowRoot {
  readonly attribute CustomElementRegistry? customElementRegistry;
};
Document includes DocumentOrShadowRoot;
ShadowRoot includes DocumentOrShadowRoot;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R13">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>Element must expose an attachShadow() method.</description>
    <spec_quote>ShadowRoot attachShadow(ShadowRootInit init);</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R14">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The ShadowRootInit dictionary must define a required mode member.</description>
    <spec_quote>required ShadowRootMode mode;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R15">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The ShadowRootInit dictionary must define a delegatesFocus member.</description>
    <spec_quote>boolean delegatesFocus = false;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R16">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The ShadowRootInit dictionary must define a serializable member.</description>
    <spec_quote>boolean serializable = false;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R17">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The ShadowRootInit dictionary must define a slotAssignment member.</description>
    <spec_quote>SlotAssignmentMode slotAssignment = "named";</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R18">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The ShadowRootInit dictionary must define a clonable member.</description>
    <spec_quote>boolean clonable = false;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R19">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The ShadowRootInit dictionary must define a customElementRegistry member.</description>
    <spec_quote>dictionary ShadowRootInit {
  required ShadowRootMode mode;
  boolean delegatesFocus = false;
  boolean serializable = false;
  SlotAssignmentMode slotAssignment = "named";
  boolean clonable = false;
  CustomElementRegistry? customElementRegistry;
};</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R20">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>Element must expose a readonly shadowRoot property.</description>
    <spec_quote>readonly attribute ShadowRoot? shadowRoot;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R21">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>Element must expose a slot property.</description>
    <spec_quote>[CEReactions, Unscopable] attribute DOMString slot;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R22">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>Element must include the Slottable mixin, exposing a readonly assignedSlot property.</description>
    <spec_quote>interface mixin Slottable {
  readonly attribute HTMLSlotElement? assignedSlot;
};
Element includes Slottable;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R23">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>Text must include the Slottable mixin, exposing a readonly assignedSlot property.</description>
    <spec_quote>interface mixin Slottable {
  readonly attribute HTMLSlotElement? assignedSlot;
};
Element includes Slottable;
Text includes Slottable;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R24">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>Node must expose a getRootNode() method.</description>
    <spec_quote>Node getRootNode(optional GetRootNodeOptions options = {});</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R25">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The GetRootNodeOptions dictionary must define a composed member.</description>
    <spec_quote>dictionary GetRootNodeOptions {
  boolean composed = false;
};</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R26">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>Node must expose a readonly isConnected property.</description>
    <spec_quote>readonly attribute boolean isConnected;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R27">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>Event must expose a composedPath() method.</description>
    <spec_quote>sequence<EventTarget> composedPath();</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R28">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>Event must expose a readonly composed property.</description>
    <spec_quote>readonly attribute boolean composed;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R29">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The EventInit dictionary must define a composed member.</description>
    <spec_quote>dictionary EventInit {
  boolean bubbles = false;
  boolean cancelable = false;
  boolean composed = false;
};</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R30">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Calling attachShadow(init) on a valid shadow host element must attach a ShadowRoot configured with init's mode, delegatesFocus, serializable, slotAssignment, clonable, and resolved customElementRegistry, and return that ShadowRoot.</description>
    <spec_quote>4. Run [attach a shadow root](#concept-attach-a-shadow-root) with this,
   init["`mode`"],
   init["`delegatesFocus`"],
   init["`serializable`"],
   init["`slotAssignment`"],
   init["`clonable`"], and registry.
5. Return this’s [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R31">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Elements in the HTML namespace whose local name is a valid custom element name or one of article, aside, blockquote, body, div, footer, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, header, main, nav, p, section, or span must be accepted as valid shadow hosts by attachShadow().</description>
    <spec_quote>A valid shadow host name is:

* a valid custom element name
* "`article`",
  "`aside`",
  "`blockquote`",
  "`body`",
  "`div`",
  "`footer`",
  "`h1`",
  "`h2`",
  "`h3`",
  "`h4`",
  "`h5`",
  "`h6`",
  "`header`",
  "`main`",
  "`nav`",
  "`p`",
  "`section`", or
  "`span`"</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R32">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When a shadow root is attached to a host element, its host attribute must return that element.</description>
    <spec_quote>6. Set shadow’s [host](#concept-documentfragment-host) to element.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R33">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When a shadow root is created and attached to a host element, its node document (ownerDocument) must be set to the host element's node document.</description>
    <spec_quote>5. Let shadow be the result of [creating a node](#create-a-node) that implements
   `ShadowRoot`, given element’s [node document](#concept-node-document).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R34">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>A shadow root's mode getter must return the ShadowRootMode value ("open" or "closed") specified in ShadowRootInit.mode.</description>
    <spec_quote>7. Set shadow’s [mode](#shadowroot-mode) to mode.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R35">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>If the delegatesFocus dictionary member is omitted from ShadowRootInit, it must default to false; otherwise shadowRoot.delegatesFocus must reflect the provided boolean value.</description>
    <spec_quote>boolean delegatesFocus = false;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R36">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>If the serializable dictionary member is omitted from ShadowRootInit, it must default to false; otherwise shadowRoot.serializable must reflect the provided boolean value.</description>
    <spec_quote>boolean serializable = false;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R37">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>If the slotAssignment dictionary member is omitted from ShadowRootInit, it must default to "named"; otherwise shadowRoot.slotAssignment must reflect the provided SlotAssignmentMode value ("named" or "manual").</description>
    <spec_quote>SlotAssignmentMode slotAssignment = "named";</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R38">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>If the clonable dictionary member is omitted from ShadowRootInit, it must default to false; otherwise shadowRoot.clonable must reflect the provided boolean value.</description>
    <spec_quote>boolean clonable = false;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R39">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>If the customElementRegistry dictionary member is omitted from ShadowRootInit, shadowRoot.customElementRegistry must default to the host element's node document's customElementRegistry.</description>
    <spec_quote>1. Let registry be this’s [node document](#concept-node-document)’s
   [custom element registry](#document-custom-element-registry).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R40">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>If the customElementRegistry dictionary member is provided in ShadowRootInit (such as a scoped CustomElementRegistry or null), shadowRoot.customElementRegistry must be set to that registry.</description>
    <spec_quote>2. If init["`customElementRegistry`"] exists, then
   set registry to it.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R41">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When an element has an attached shadow root whose mode is "open", element.shadowRoot must return that ShadowRoot.</description>
    <spec_quote>The `shadowRoot` getter steps are:

1. Let shadow be this’s [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root).
2. If shadow is null or its [mode](#shadowroot-mode) is "`closed`",
   then return null.
3. Return shadow.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R42">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When an element has an attached shadow root whose mode is "closed", element.shadowRoot must return null.</description>
    <spec_quote>2. If shadow is null or its [mode](#shadowroot-mode) is "`closed`",
   then return null.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R43">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Calling attachShadow(init) on a shadow host that already has a declarative shadow root with the same mode must remove all children of that shadow root in tree order, clear its declarative state, and return that existing shadow root.</description>
    <spec_quote>3. [Remove](#concept-node-remove) all of currentShadowRoot’s [children](#concept-tree-child), in
      [tree order](#concept-tree-order).
   4. Set currentShadowRoot’s [declarative](#shadowroot-declarative) to false.
   5. Return.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R44">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>An element participating in a shadow tree must be able to host its own shadow tree, enabling nested shadow trees.</description>
    <spec_quote>A [shadow tree](#concept-shadow-tree)’s corresponding [light tree](#concept-light-tree) can be a [shadow tree](#concept-shadow-tree)
itself.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R45">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>A node inside a shadow tree (including nested shadow trees) must have isConnected return true if its shadow-including root is a Document, and false otherwise.</description>
    <spec_quote>A [node](#concept-node) is connected if its
[shadow-including root](#concept-shadow-including-root) is a [document](#concept-document).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R46">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Calling getRootNode() with no arguments or with { composed: false } on a node inside a shadow tree must return that tree's ShadowRoot.</description>
    <spec_quote>The `getRootNode(options)` method steps are to
return this’s [shadow-including root](#concept-shadow-including-root) if
options["`composed`"] is true; otherwise this’s
[root](#concept-tree-root).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R47">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Calling getRootNode({ composed: true }) on a node inside a shadow tree (including nested shadow trees) must cross shadow host boundaries and return the outermost shadow-including root.</description>
    <spec_quote>The shadow-including root of an object is its
[root](#concept-tree-root)’s [host](#concept-documentfragment-host)’s [shadow-including root](#concept-shadow-including-root), if the
object’s [root](#concept-tree-root) is a [shadow root](#concept-shadow-root); otherwise its [root](#concept-tree-root).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R48">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>ShadowRoot must inherit from DocumentFragment, exposing DocumentFragment, ParentNode, and NonElementParentNode APIs (such as getElementById, querySelector, querySelectorAll, and child manipulation) scoped to the shadow tree.</description>
    <spec_quote>interface ShadowRoot : DocumentFragment {</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R49">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Calling contains(other) on a shadow host or light-tree ancestor with a node inside a shadow tree must return false because shadow-tree nodes are not inclusive descendants of the host in the light tree.</description>
    <spec_quote>The `contains(other)` method steps are to return
true if other is an [inclusive descendant](#concept-tree-inclusive-descendant) of this; otherwise false
(including when other is null).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R50">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Calling compareDocumentPosition() between a node in a shadow tree and a node in its light tree must include DOCUMENT_POSITION_DISCONNECTED because the two nodes have different tree roots.</description>
    <spec_quote>6. If node1 or node2 is null, or node1’s [root](#concept-tree-root) is
   not node2’s [root](#concept-tree-root), then return the result of adding
   `DOCUMENT_POSITION_DISCONNECTED`, `DOCUMENT_POSITION_IMPLEMENTATION_SPECIFIC`, and
   either `DOCUMENT_POSITION_PRECEDING` or `DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING`, with the
   constraint that this is to be consistent, together.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R51">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>A MutationObserver observing a shadow host with subtree set to true must not receive mutation records for mutations occurring inside its shadow tree because mutation record queuing only traverses inclusive ancestors within the same node tree.</description>
    <spec_quote>2. Let nodes be the [inclusive ancestors](#concept-tree-inclusive-ancestor) of target.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R52">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>The slot IDL attribute on Element must reflect the element's slot content attribute.</description>
    <spec_quote>The `slot` attribute must [reflect](#concept-reflect)
"`slot`".</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R53">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>In a shadow tree with "named" slot assignment, a slottable (Element or Text) child of the shadow host must be assigned to the first slot element in tree order within the shadow root's descendants whose name equals the slottable's slot name (defaulting to the empty string).</description>
    <spec_quote>6. Return the first [slot](#concept-slot) in [tree order](#concept-tree-order) in shadow’s
   [descendants](#concept-tree-descendant) whose [name](#slot-name) is slottable’s
   [name](#slotable-name), if any; otherwise null.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R54">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>For a slot in a shadow tree with "named" slot assignment, its assigned nodes must consist of all matching slottable children of the shadow host in tree order.</description>
    <spec_quote>6. Otherwise, for each [slottable](#concept-slotable) [child](#concept-tree-child) slottable of
   host, in [tree order](#concept-tree-order):

   1. Let foundSlot be the result of [finding a slot](#find-a-slot) given
      slottable.
   2. If foundSlot is slot, then append
      slottable to result.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R55">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>In a shadow tree with "manual" slot assignment, a slottable child of the shadow host must only be assigned to the slot within the shadow root's descendants whose manually assigned nodes contain that slottable.</description>
    <spec_quote>5. If shadow’s [slot assignment](#shadowroot-slot-assignment) is "`manual`", then
   return the [slot](#concept-slot) in shadow’s [descendants](#concept-tree-descendant) whose
   manually assigned nodes contains slottable, if any; otherwise
   null.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R56">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>For a slot in a shadow tree with "manual" slot assignment, its assigned nodes must include only those slottables from its manually assigned nodes whose parent is the shadow root's host, preserving their manually assigned order.</description>
    <spec_quote>5. If root’s [slot assignment](#shadowroot-slot-assignment) is "`manual`":

   1. For each [slottable](#concept-slotable) slottable of slot’s
      manually assigned nodes, if slottable’s [parent](#concept-tree-parent) is
      host, append slottable to result.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R57">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>On an Element or Text node assigned to a slot inside an "open" shadow root, the assignedSlot getter must return that HTMLSlotElement.</description>
    <spec_quote>The `assignedSlot`
getter steps are to return the result of [find a slot](#find-a-slot) given this and true.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R58">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>On an Element or Text node that is a child of a shadow host with a "closed" shadow root, the assignedSlot getter must return null.</description>
    <spec_quote>4. If open is true and shadow’s [mode](#shadowroot-mode) is not
   "`open`", then return null.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R59">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When finding flattened slottables for a slot that has no assigned slottables, the slot's own slottable children in tree order must be used as fallback content.</description>
    <spec_quote>4. If slottables is the empty list, then append each [slottable](#concept-slotable)
   [child](#concept-tree-child) of slot, in [tree order](#concept-tree-order), to slottables.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R60">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When finding flattened slottables for a slot, any node that is itself a slot inside a shadow tree must be recursively replaced in order by that nested slot's flattened slottables.</description>
    <spec_quote>5. For each node of slottables:

   1. If node is a [slot](#concept-slot) whose [root](#concept-tree-root) is a [shadow root](#concept-shadow-root):

      1. Let temporaryResult be the result of [finding flattened slottables](#find-flattened-slotables) given
         node.
      2. Append each [slottable](#concept-slotable) in temporaryResult, in order, to
         result.
   2. Otherwise, append node to result.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R61">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Changing a slot element's name attribute to a distinct value (treating null and the empty string equivalently as the empty string) must update the slot's name and reassign slottables for its shadow tree.</description>
    <spec_quote>1. If element is a [slot](#concept-slot), localName is `name`, and
   namespace is null:

   1. If value is oldValue, then return.
   2. If value is null and oldValue is the empty string, then return.
   3. If value is the empty string and oldValue is null, then return.
   4. If value is null or the empty string, then set element’s
      [name](#slot-name) to the empty string.
   5. Otherwise, set element’s [name](#slot-name) to value.
   6. Run [assign slottables for a tree](#assign-slotables-for-a-tree) with element’s [root](#concept-tree-root).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R62">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Changing an element's slot attribute to a distinct value (treating null and the empty string equivalently as the empty string) must update its slottable name, reassign slottables for its previously assigned slot if any, and assign a slot for the element.</description>
    <spec_quote>1. If localName is `slot` and namespace is null:

   1. If value is oldValue, then return.
   2. If value is null and oldValue is the empty string, then return.
   3. If value is the empty string and oldValue is null, then return.
   4. If value is null or the empty string, then set element’s
      [name](#slotable-name) to the empty string.
   5. Otherwise, set element’s [name](#slotable-name) to value.
   6. If element is [assigned](#slotable-assigned), then run [assign slottables](#assign-slotables)
      for element’s [assigned slot](#slotable-assigned-slot).
   7. Run [assign a slot](#assign-a-slot) for element.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R63">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Inserting a slottable child into a shadow host whose shadow root uses "named" slot assignment must assign a slot for that inserted node.</description>
    <spec_quote>4. If parent is a [shadow host](#element-shadow-host) whose [shadow root](#concept-shadow-root)’s
      [slot assignment](#shadowroot-slot-assignment) is "`named`" and node is a
      [slottable](#concept-slotable), then [assign a slot](#assign-a-slot) for node.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R64">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Removing a slottable node that is currently assigned to a slot must update the assigned nodes of its previously assigned slot.</description>
    <spec_quote>8. If node is [assigned](#slotable-assigned), then run [assign slottables](#assign-slotables) for
   node’s [assigned slot](#slotable-assigned-slot).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R65">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Inserting a node (such as a slot element) into a shadow tree must run assign slottables for the shadow tree so matching host children are assigned to the slot.</description>
    <spec_quote>6. Run [assign slottables for a tree](#assign-slotables-for-a-tree) with node’s [root](#concept-tree-root).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R66">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Removing a node that is or contains a slot element must run assign slottables for both the old parent's tree root and the removed node's subtree.</description>
    <spec_quote>10. If node has an [inclusive descendant](#concept-tree-inclusive-descendant) that is a [slot](#concept-slot):

    1. Run [assign slottables for a tree](#assign-slotables-for-a-tree) with parent’s [root](#concept-tree-root).
    2. Run [assign slottables for a tree](#assign-slotables-for-a-tree) with node.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R67">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Moving an assigned slottable node via moveBefore() must update the assigned nodes of its previously assigned slot.</description>
    <spec_quote>14. If node is [assigned](#slotable-assigned), then run [assign slottables](#assign-slotables) for
    node’s [assigned slot](#slotable-assigned-slot).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R68">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Moving a slottable node via moveBefore() into a shadow host whose shadow root uses "named" slot assignment must assign a slot for that node.</description>
    <spec_quote>22. If newParent is a [shadow host](#element-shadow-host) whose [shadow root](#concept-shadow-root)’s
    [slot assignment](#shadowroot-slot-assignment) is "`named`" and node is a
    [slottable](#concept-slotable), then [assign a slot](#assign-a-slot) for node.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R69">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When slot assignment changes a slot's list of assigned nodes compared to its previous assigned nodes, a slot change must be signaled for that slot.</description>
    <spec_quote>2. If slottables and slot’s [assigned nodes](#slot-assigned-nodes) are not
   identical, then run [signal a slot change](#signal-a-slot-change) for slot.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R70">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>For each signaled slot, a slotchange event with bubbles set to true must be fired at that slot during the mutation observer microtask after mutation observer callbacks have run.</description>
    <spec_quote>7. For each slot of signalSet: [fire an event](#concept-event-fire) named

   node’s [assigned slot](#slotable-assigned-slot).
9. If parent’s [root](#concept-tree-root) is a [shadow root](#concept-shadow-root), and
   parent is a [slot](#concept-slot) whose [assigned nodes](#slot-assigned-nodes) is the empty list,
   then run [signal a slot change](#signal-a-slot-change) for parent.
10. If node has an [inclusive descendant](#concept-tree-inclusive-descendant) that is a [slot](#concept-slot):

    1. Run [assign slottables for a tree](#assign-slotables-for-a-tree) with parent’s [root](#concept-tree-root).
    2. Run [assign slottables for a tree](#assign-slotables-for-a-tree) with node.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R149">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When moving a node out of its old parent via moveBefore(), slot assignments must be updated for its assigned slot if it was assigned, a slot change must be signaled if the old parent is an empty slot in a shadow tree, and slottables must be reassigned for the old parent's root and the moved node if the moved node contains a slot.</description>
    <spec_quote>14. If node is [assigned](#slotable-assigned), then run [assign slottables](#assign-slotables) for
    node’s [assigned slot](#slotable-assigned-slot).
15. If oldParent’s [root](#concept-tree-root) is a [shadow root](#concept-shadow-root), and
    oldParent is a [slot](#concept-slot) whose [assigned nodes](#slot-assigned-nodes)
    is empty, then run [signal a slot change](#signal-a-slot-change) for oldParent.
16. If node has an [inclusive descendant](#concept-tree-inclusive-descendant) that is a [slot](#concept-slot):

    1. Run [assign slottables for a tree](#assign-slotables-for-a-tree) with oldParent’s [root](#concept-tree-root).
    2. Run [assign slottables for a tree](#assign-slotables-for-a-tree) with node.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R150">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When moving a node into its new parent via moveBefore(), a slot must be assigned if the new parent is a shadow host with named slot assignment and the node is a slottable, a slot change must be signaled if the new parent is an empty slot in a shadow tree, and slottables must be reassigned for the node's root tree.</description>
    <spec_quote>22. If newParent is a [shadow host](#element-shadow-host) whose [shadow root](#concept-shadow-root)’s
    [slot assignment](#shadowroot-slot-assignment) is "`named`" and node is a
    [slottable](#concept-slotable), then [assign a slot](#assign-a-slot) for node.
23. If newParent’s [root](#concept-tree-root) is a [shadow root](#concept-shadow-root), and
    newParent is a [slot](#concept-slot) whose [assigned nodes](#slot-assigned-nodes)
    is empty, then run [signal a slot change](#signal-a-slot-change) for newParent.
24. Run [assign slottables for a tree](#assign-slotables-for-a-tree) with node’s [root](#concept-tree-root).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R151">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When inserting nodes into a DOM tree, platform post-connection steps must be collected and executed in shadow-including tree order for all shadow-including inclusive descendants that are connected.</description>
    <spec_quote>11. For each node of nodes, in [tree order](#concept-tree-order):

    1. For each [shadow-including inclusive descendant](#concept-shadow-including-inclusive-descendant) inclusiveDescendant of
       node, in [shadow-including tree order](#concept-shadow-including-tree-order): append
       inclusiveDescendant to staticNodeList.
12. For each node of staticNodeList: if node is
    [connected](#connected), then run the [post-connection steps](#concept-node-post-connection-ext) with node.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R152">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>Calling Node.prototype.cloneNode() directly on a ShadowRoot must throw a NotSupportedError DOMException.</description>
    <spec_quote>1. If this is a [shadow root](#concept-shadow-root), then throw a
   "`NotSupportedError`" `DOMException`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R153">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>Cloning an element that is a shadow host whose shadow root has clonable set to true (via cloneNode() or importNode()) must attach a shadow root with the same mode, delegatesFocus, serializable, slotAssignment, declarative, keep custom element registry null, and clonable true to the clone, and must deep-clone all children of the original shadow root into the cloned shadow root even if subtree is false.</description>
    <spec_quote>6. If node is an [element](#concept-element), node is a
   [shadow host](#element-shadow-host), and node’s [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root)’s
   [clonable](#shadowroot-clonable) is true:

   1. Assert: copy is not a [shadow host](#element-shadow-host).
   2. Let shadowRootRegistry be node’s [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root)’s
      [custom element registry](#shadowroot-custom-element-registry).
   3. If shadowRootRegistry [is a global custom element registry](#is-a-global-custom-element-registry), then set
      shadowRootRegistry to document’s
      [custom element registry](#document-custom-element-registry)’s [effective global custom element registry](#effective-global-custom-element-registry).
   4. [Attach a shadow root](#concept-attach-a-shadow-root) with copy, node’s
      [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root)’s [mode](#shadowroot-mode), node’s
      [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root)’s [delegates focus](#shadowroot-delegates-focus), node’s
      [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root)’s [serializable](#shadowroot-serializable), node’s
      [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root)’s [slot assignment](#shadowroot-slot-assignment), true, and
      shadowRootRegistry.
   5. Set copy’s [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root)’s [declarative](#shadowroot-declarative)
      to node’s [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root)’s [declarative](#shadowroot-declarative).
   6. Set copy’s [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root)’s
      [keep custom element registry null](#shadowroot-keep-custom-element-registry-null) to node’s
      [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root)’s [keep custom element registry null](#shadowroot-keep-custom-element-registry-null).
   7. For each child of node’s [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root)’s
      [children](#concept-tree-child), in [tree order](#concept-tree-order): [clone a node](#concept-node-clone) given child with
      [*document*](#clone-a-node-document) set to document,
      [*subtree*](#clone-a-node-subtree) set to true, and
      [*parent*](#clone-a-node-parent) set to copy’s [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R154">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When cloning a shadow host with a clonable shadow root into a target document, if the original shadow root's custom element registry is a global custom element registry, the cloned shadow root must use the target document's effective global custom element registry (while scoped or null registries are preserved).</description>
    <spec_quote>   2. Let shadowRootRegistry be node’s [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root)’s
      [custom element registry](#shadowroot-custom-element-registry).
   3. If shadowRootRegistry [is a global custom element registry](#is-a-global-custom-element-registry), then set
      shadowRootRegistry to document’s
      [custom element registry](#document-custom-element-registry)’s [effective global custom element registry](#effective-global-custom-element-registry).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R155">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When cloning a Document, the cloned document must copy the original document's allow declarative shadow roots flag.</description>
    <spec_quote>       1. Set copy’s [encoding](#concept-document-encoding), [content type](#concept-document-content-type),
          [URL](#concept-document-url), [origin](#concept-document-origin), [type](#concept-document-type),
          [mode](#concept-document-mode), and [allow declarative shadow roots](#document-allow-declarative-shadow-roots), to those of
          node.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R156">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>Calling Document.prototype.importNode() with a ShadowRoot must throw a NotSupportedError DOMException.</description>
    <spec_quote>1. If node is a [document](#concept-document) or [shadow root](#concept-shadow-root), then throw
   a "`NotSupportedError`" `DOMException`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R157">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>Calling Document.prototype.adoptNode() with a ShadowRoot must throw a HierarchyRequestError DOMException.</description>
    <spec_quote>2. If node is a [shadow root](#concept-shadow-root), then throw a

  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R158">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When adopting a node into a different document, the node document of all shadow-including inclusive descendants (including shadow roots and nodes inside shadow trees) must be updated to the target document in shadow-including tree order.</description>
    <spec_quote>3. If document is not oldDocument, then for each
   inclusiveDescendant of node’s [shadow-including inclusive descendants](#concept-shadow-including-inclusive-descendant),
   in [shadow-including tree order](#concept-shadow-including-tree-order):

   1. Set inclusiveDescendant’s [node document](#concept-node-document) to document.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R159">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>ShadowRoot must include DocumentOrShadowRoot and its customElementRegistry getter must return the shadow root's associated CustomElementRegistry (or null).</description>
    <spec_quote>The `customElementRegistry` getter steps
are:

1. If this is a [document](#concept-document), then return this’s
   [custom element registry](#document-custom-element-registry).
2. Assert: this is a `ShadowRoot` [node](#concept-node).
3. Return this’s [custom element registry](#shadowroot-custom-element-registry).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R160">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>Element.prototype.attachShadow() must default the shadow root's custom element registry to the host's node document's custom element registry unless init.customElementRegistry is specified, and must throw a NotSupportedError DOMException if the resulting registry is a non-null global (non-scoped) custom element registry that is not the host's node document's custom element registry.</description>
    <spec_quote>1. Let registry be this’s [node document](#concept-node-document)’s
   [custom element registry](#document-custom-element-registry).
2. If init["`customElementRegistry`"] exists, then
   set registry to it.
3. If registry is non-null, registry’s
   is scoped is false, and registry is not this’s
   [node document](#concept-node-document)’s [custom element registry](#document-custom-element-registry), then throw a
   "`NotSupportedError`" `DOMException`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R161">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>Element.prototype.attachShadow() must throw a NotSupportedError DOMException when invoked on an element with a valid custom element name or non-null is value whose custom element definition has disable shadow set to true.</description>
    <spec_quote>3. If element’s [local name](#concept-element-local-name) is a valid custom element name, or
   element’s [`is` value](#concept-element-is-value) is non-null:

   1. Let definition be the result of looking up a custom element definition
      given element’s [custom element registry](#element-custom-element-registry), its
      [namespace](#concept-element-namespace), its [local name](#concept-element-local-name), and its
      [`is` value](#concept-element-is-value).
   2. If definition is non-null and definition’s
      disable shadow is true, then throw a
      "`NotSupportedError`" `DOMException`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R162">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When attaching a shadow root to an element whose custom element state is precustomized or custom, the shadow root's available to element internals flag must be set to true.</description>
    <spec_quote>9. If element’s [custom element state](#concept-element-custom-element-state) is
   "`precustomized`" or "`custom`", then set shadow’s
   [available to element internals](#shadowroot-available-to-element-internals) to true.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R163">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When attachShadow() is called on a shadow host that already has a declarative shadow root with matching mode, all children of the existing shadow root must be removed in tree order, its declarative flag must be set to false, and that existing shadow root must be returned; if the existing shadow root is not declarative or its mode differs, a NotSupportedError DOMException must be thrown.</description>
    <spec_quote>4. If element is a [shadow host](#element-shadow-host):

   1. Let currentShadowRoot be element’s [shadow root](#concept-element-shadow-root).
   2. If any of the following are true:

      * currentShadowRoot’s [declarative](#shadowroot-declarative) is false; or
      * currentShadowRoot’s [mode](#shadowroot-mode) is not mode,

      then throw a "`NotSupportedError`" `DOMException`.
   3. [Remove](#concept-node-remove) all of currentShadowRoot’s [children](#concept-tree-child), in
      [tree order](#concept-tree-order).
   4. Set currentShadowRoot’s [declarative](#shadowroot-declarative) to false.
   5. Return.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R164">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When inserting a node, for each connected element among its shadow-including inclusive descendants in shadow-including tree order that has a non-null custom element registry, its node document must be appended to the registry's scoped document set if scoped, and connectedCallback must be enqueued if the element is custom or an upgrade must be attempted otherwise.</description>
    <spec_quote>   7. For each [shadow-including inclusive descendant](#concept-shadow-including-inclusive-descendant) inclusiveDescendant of
      node, in [shadow-including tree order](#concept-shadow-including-tree-order):

      1. If inclusiveDescendant is [connected](#connected), inclusiveDescendant is an
         [element](#concept-element), and inclusiveDescendant’s
         [custom element registry](#element-custom-element-registry) is non-null:

         1. If inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#element-custom-element-registry)’s
            is scoped is true, then append
            inclusiveDescendant’s [node document](#concept-node-document) to
            inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#element-custom-element-registry)’s
            scoped document set.
         2. If inclusiveDescendant is [custom](#concept-element-custom), then
            enqueue a custom element callback reaction with inclusiveDescendant,
            callback name "`connectedCallback`", and « ».
         3. Otherwise, try to upgrade
            inclusiveDescendant.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R165">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When inserting a node, for each connected shadow root among its shadow-including inclusive descendants that has a non-null scoped custom element registry, the shadow root's node document must be appended to that registry's scoped document set.</description>
    <spec_quote>      2. Otherwise, if inclusiveDescendant is [connected](#connected),
         inclusiveDescendant is a [shadow root](#concept-shadow-root),
         inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#shadowroot-custom-element-registry) is non-null, and
         inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#shadowroot-custom-element-registry)’s
         is scoped is true, then append
         inclusiveDescendant’s [node document](#concept-node-document) to
         inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#shadowroot-custom-element-registry)’s
         scoped document set.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R166">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When removing a node whose parent is connected, a disconnectedCallback custom element reaction must be enqueued for each custom element among the node's shadow-including descendants in shadow-including tree order.</description>
    <spec_quote>14. For each [shadow-including descendant](#concept-shadow-including-descendant) descendant of node, in
    [shadow-including tree order](#concept-shadow-including-tree-order):

    1. If descendant is [custom](#concept-element-custom) and isParentConnected
       is true, then enqueue a custom element callback reaction with descendant,
       callback name "`disconnectedCallback`", and « ».</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R167">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When moving a node into a connected parent via moveBefore(), a connectedMoveCallback custom element reaction must be enqueued for each custom element among the node's shadow-including inclusive descendants in shadow-including tree order.</description>
    <spec_quote>25. For each [shadow-including inclusive descendant](#concept-shadow-including-inclusive-descendant) inclusiveDescendant of
    node, in [shadow-including tree order](#concept-shadow-including-tree-order):

    1. Let isSubtreeRoot be true if inclusiveDescendant is
       node; otherwise false.
    2. If inclusiveDescendant is [custom](#concept-element-custom) and newParent is
       [connected](#connected), then enqueue a custom element callback reaction with
       inclusiveDescendant, callback name "`connectedMoveCallback`", and « ».</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R168">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When adopting a node into a different document, for each shadow root in its shadow-including inclusive descendants whose custom element registry is either null (with keep custom element registry null false) or a global custom element registry, the shadow root's custom element registry must be updated to the target document's effective global custom element registry.</description>
    <spec_quote>   2. If inclusiveDescendant is a [shadow root](#concept-shadow-root) and if any of the following
      are true:

      * inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#shadowroot-custom-element-registry) is null
        and inclusiveDescendant’s [keep custom element registry null](#shadowroot-keep-custom-element-registry-null) is
        false; or
      * inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#shadowroot-custom-element-registry)
        [is a global custom element registry](#is-a-global-custom-element-registry),

      then set inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#shadowroot-custom-element-registry) to
      document’s [custom element registry](#document-custom-element-registry)’s
      [effective global custom element registry](#effective-global-custom-element-registry).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R169">
    <category>Integration</category>
    <description>When adopting a node into a different document, an adoptedCallback custom element reaction (with oldDocument and document) must be enqueued for every custom element among the node's shadow-including inclusive descendants in shadow-including tree order.</description>
    <spec_quote>3. If document is not oldDocument, then for each
   inclusiveDescendant of node’s [shadow-including inclusive descendants](#concept-shadow-including-inclusive-descendant),
   in [shadow-including tree order](#concept-shadow-including-tree-order):

   1. Set inclusiveDescendant’s [node document](#concept-node-document) to document.
   2. If inclusiveDescendant is a [shadow root](#concept-shadow-root) and if any of the following
      are true:

      * inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#shadowroot-custom-element-registry) is null
        and inclusiveDescendant’s [keep custom element registry null](#shadowroot-keep-custom-element-registry-null) is
        false; or
      * inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#shadowroot-custom-element-registry)
        [is a global custom element registry](#is-a-global-custom-element-registry),

      then set inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#shadowroot-custom-element-registry) to
      document’s [custom element registry](#document-custom-element-registry)’s
      [effective global custom element registry](#effective-global-custom-element-registry).
   3. Otherwise, if inclusiveDescendant is an [element](#concept-element):

      1. Set the [node document](#concept-node-document) of each [attribute](#concept-attribute) in
         inclusiveDescendant’s [attribute list](#concept-element-attribute) to document.
      2. If any of the following are true:

         * inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#element-custom-element-registry) is null
           and inclusiveDescendant’s
           [keep custom element registry null](#element-keep-custom-element-registry-null) is false; or
         * inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#element-custom-element-registry)
           [is a global custom element registry](#is-a-global-custom-element-registry),

         then:

         1. Let registry be null.
         2. If inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#element-custom-element-registry) is
            non-null, inclusiveDescendant’s [parent](#concept-tree-parent) is null, or
            inclusiveDescendant’s [parent](#concept-tree-parent) is an
            [exclusive `DocumentFragment` node](#exclusive-documentfragment-node), then set registry to
            document’s [custom element registry](#document-custom-element-registry).
         3. Otherwise, set registry to the result of
            looking up a custom element registry given inclusiveDescendant’s
            [parent](#concept-tree-parent).
         4. Set inclusiveDescendant’s [custom element registry](#element-custom-element-registry) to
            registry’s [effective global custom element registry](#effective-global-custom-element-registry).
      3. If inclusiveDescendant is [custom](#concept-element-custom), then
         enqueue a custom element callback reaction with inclusiveDescendant, callback
         name "`adoptedCallback`", and « oldDocument, document ».</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
